title: Telemetry snapshot microcanvas: compact insight tiles + axial tracecards for onboarding
creator: Maya Chen
description: Deliver a compact set of onboarding visuals (microcanvas) that illustrate key observability surfaces in the Console quickstart: latency histogram with per-route heatbars, cost-per-token sparkline overlays, and an axial tracecard view showing span breakdown and KV cache hits. The goal is to produce export-ready PNG/JPEG hero screenshots, a short looping GIF for the product page, and annotated assets for docs and release notes. Visuals should be legible at 1024px width and provide accessible color contrasts for the heatbars and sparklines.
acceptance_criteria: Six export-ready screenshots: three desktop (1024px width) and three mobile crops (640px width) covering latency, cost-per-token, and tracecard views
Annotated overlays for documentation that call out: SLA baseline, peak latency region, cost hotspots, and span-level timings
One looping GIF (max 6s, <2MB) demonstrating hover-disclosure on a tracecard and sparkline tooltip with per-token cost
Contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for text/icons on all hero screens and colorblind-friendly palette for heatbars
Figma file cleaned up with components and export slices; handoff in Slack + comment on related PR
handoff_notes: Engineering: slices exported from Figma with exact layer names matching RW console CSS tokens (see figma layers list)
PM: Use hero-telemetry-1024.png for the quickstart modal; use GIF in marketing CTA; link to docs section 'Quickstart: Understand your first 1000 tokens'
Accessibility: run screenshots through Axe snapshot test and attach results to PR before merging
Follow-up: iterate on tracecard microcopy after initial telemetry data review (ENG-4821)

design_notes: Prefer micro-interaction frames: hover -> highlight span -> tooltip with 'token cost' and 'KV hits'
Tracecard layout: left column = request metadata (route, model, duration), middle = span waterfall (compact), right = cache & cost badges
Latency histogram: overlay a percentile line (95th) and annotate SLA threshold; use subtle gridlines to keep the hero uncluttered
Cost-per-token sparkline: include dashed baseline showing average per-route cost for comparison
Export specs: PNG@2x for hero, SVG for trace glyphs, GIF for micro-interaction loop
